# Factor-neutral-by-construction seed templates (Task B3).
# Format: `<id>: <dsl-expression>`. Lines beginning with '#' are comments.
# All expressions parse + typecheck against a panel carrying:
#   close, raw_close, volume, high, low, open, market_cap, sector,
#   earnFlag, atmCenI_21d, atmCenI_126d, nEarnCnt_5d, returns.
# Ops used: cs_residualize, ts_mean, ts_std, rank, zscore (all in registry.cpp).
# Convention:
#   *_ss  = sector+size-neutral: cs_residualize(<signal>, sector, market_cap)
#   *_s   = sector-only-neutral: cs_residualize(<signal>, sector)

# ---- Momentum (12-1) — sector+size-neutral ----------------------------------
mom_ss1: cs_residualize(ts_mean(returns, 252) - ts_mean(returns, 21), sector, market_cap)

# Ranked momentum, sector+size-neutral
mom_ss2: cs_residualize(rank(ts_mean(returns, 252) - ts_mean(returns, 21)), sector, market_cap)

# Sector-only sibling for comparison
mom_s1: cs_residualize(ts_mean(returns, 252) - ts_mean(returns, 21), sector)

# ---- Low-volatility anomaly — sector+size-neutral ---------------------------
lv_ss1: cs_residualize(-1 * ts_std(returns, 20), sector, market_cap)

# Z-scored low-vol, sector+size-neutral
lv_ss2: cs_residualize(zscore(-1 * ts_std(returns, 20)), sector, market_cap)

# Sector-only sibling
lv_s1: cs_residualize(-1 * ts_std(returns, 20), sector)

# ---- Short-term reversal — sector+size-neutral ------------------------------
rev_ss1: cs_residualize(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5), sector, market_cap)

# Sector-only sibling
rev_s1: cs_residualize(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5), sector)

# ---- IV term-structure slope — sector+size-neutral --------------------------
ivts_ss1: cs_residualize(rank(atmCenI_21d / atmCenI_126d), sector, market_cap)

# IV vs realized vol gap, sector+size-neutral
ivrv_ss1: cs_residualize(rank(atmCenI_21d - ts_std(returns, 21)), sector, market_cap)

# Sector-only IV sibling
ivts_s1: cs_residualize(rank(atmCenI_21d / atmCenI_126d), sector)
